## InputGroup.svelte

### `interface Props`

- `size` :: The control height. Text follows this unless `textSize` is set. @default 'lg'
- `textSize` :: The text scale, independent of the control height. Follows `size` when omitted.
- `shape` :: The corner shape. @default 'modern'
- `variant` :: `outline` is a bordered field, `secondary` a tinted one without a border, `ghost` is bare until hovered or focused. @default 'outline'
- `invalid` :: Marks the group invalid (red border). Inside a `Field` it follows the field's error unless set.
- `disabled` :: Disables the input inside and dims the frame.
- `children` :: The addons and the input.

## InputGroupAddon.svelte

### `interface Props`

- `align` :: Whether the addon sits at the start or the end of the group. Visual order still follows source order.
- `gap` :: Space between the icons, text or buttons inside this addon on the shared gap ladder.
- `children` :: Icons, text or buttons that belong to this side of the field.

## InputGroupButton.svelte

### `interface Props`

- `children` :: The button label, or an icon.
- `buttonProps` :: Props forwarded to the Button it renders, so a caller can change the variant, size or ink of one action.

## InputGroupInput.svelte

### `interface Props`

- `value` :: The text. Bindable; works controlled and uncontrolled.
- `onValueChange` :: Called with the new text whenever it changes.
- `ref` :: The underlying `<input>` element. Bindable, for focusing from code.

## InputGroupText.svelte

### `interface Props`

- `textSize` :: The scale of the prefix or suffix text; follows the group's `textSize` when omitted.
- `textColor` :: The ink of the prefix or suffix text, muted by default so it does not compete with the value.
- `children` :: The prefix or suffix text, such as a scheme or a unit.

## context.ts

### `interface InputGroupContext`

What an InputGroup shares with its parts.

- `id` :: The id the input should carry — the Field label's `for` points at it.
- `invalid` :: Whether the group is invalid.
- `disabled` :: Whether the group is disabled.
- `required` :: Whether the group is required.
- `describedby` :: Hint or error ids for `aria-describedby`.
- `size` :: The group's size, so the inner button can match it.
- `textSize` :: The group's text scale, when set independently of size.

### `const setInputGroupContext`

Provide the group's context to its parts.

### `function getInputGroupContext`

The enclosing group's context, or a standalone default when a part is used on its own.
